Sitting posture model — licence notice
=====================================

The shipped weights are:

    models/sitting_posture_yolo26n.pt
    app/Sources/PostureYOLO.mlmodelc   (CoreML export of the same weights)

They are a YOLO26n detector fine-tuned on a sitting-posture dataset by the
SittingPosture project. The supplied model files are listed above.

Licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
----------------------------------------------------------
YOLO26 and the pretrained checkpoints these weights were fine-tuned from are
published by Ultralytics under AGPL-3.0, so the fine-tuned weights inherit it:

  * Ultralytics licence:  https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/blob/main/LICENSE
  * Full AGPL-3.0 text:   https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.txt

The runtime that loads them (the `ultralytics` Python package used by
`app/Bridge/yolo_classroom.py`) is distributed under the same licence; the installed copy
carries its own LICENSE file in `.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ultralytics/`.

What this means in practice
---------------------------
* Using this app locally on your own machine needs no further action.
* If you distribute the app, the exported model, or anything built from these
  weights, the AGPL applies: pass on the licence and offer the corresponding
  source, including the app sources and model files in this repository.
* Commercial or closed-source distribution needs an
  [Ultralytics Enterprise licence](https://www.ultralytics.com/license) or a
  different, permissively licensed model.
